changelog:
v4.2.8 — Fixes the app closing itself during 4K series binge-watching

• Fixes the app suddenly closing or restarting while binge-watching a series in 4K — the app was loading the next episode in the background while the current one was still playing, which used too much memory on 4K and caused the device to shut it down. On 4K content it now loads the next episode the normal way (a brief moment between episodes) instead. HD and 1080p series still switch episodes seamlessly.

Includes all v4.2.7 (freeze/ANR) and v4.2.4-4.2.6 (4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby audio) fixes.
